title: since-cutoff results
description: The document that `since-cutoff scan --json` and `run --json` print and that .since-cutoff/results.json holds, for report_schema 3. Every count rests on the static API diff and the scan of the project's imports; nothing of the libraries is run.

report_schema.description: The version of this document's shape (report.REPORT_SCHEMA): it goes up when keys are added or changed. 0.3 wrote none; 2 added used, used_apis and notes_preview; 3 added settings.griffe_version.

generated_at.description: When the document was written, in UTC, to the second (ISO 8601).

model.description: The model whose training cutoff the scan compares from; null for a cutoff given alone (`scan --cutoff` without `--model`).

model_spec.description: The model as `--model` takes it (`provider:model`); null for a cutoff given alone.

effort.description: The Claude Code thinking effort of `run --effort`; null when none applies.

cutoff.description: The model's training cutoff, as a day.

cutoff_source.description: Where the cutoff comes from: a models.dev listing, the bundled snapshot, or `--cutoff`.

compare_from.description: The day the comparison releases were published by: settings.cutoff_margin days before the cutoff.

project.description: The project directory, as an absolute path.

version_source.description: Where the dependency versions come from: a lockfile, requirements files, pins in pyproject.toml, a virtual environment, or the latest releases on PyPI.

dependencies_checked.description: Of them, those whose releases could be compared (status other than skipped).

dependencies_skipped.description: Of them, those that could not be checked; each package row says why (reason).

dependencies_changed.description: Dependencies whose pinned release changed its API after the release at the cutoff (status changed).

dependencies_newer_than_model.description: Dependencies first released after the cutoff (status new): the model cannot know them at all.

breaking_changes.description: Breaking changes to public APIs found by the static diff, over all dependencies; a change reachable under several import paths counts once.

deprecations.description: New deprecations of public APIs found by the static diff, counted the same way.

internal_changes.description: Changes to internal APIs (not reached from the package's top level, named in an __all__ or documented), breaking or deprecated, counted apart from the two counts above.

warnings.description: What the scan could not do or read, in words (an unreachable PyPI, a compiled module, a dependency read by name only).

packages.description: One row per dependency, with its counts and, after `run`, its probe outcomes.

probed_dependencies.description: `run`: the dependencies with at least one valid probe.

stale_dependencies.description: `run`: the dependencies with at least one stale probe answer.

heldout.description: `run` with notes: the held-out test of the notes (heldout) and the regression check on APIs the model already got right (regression); a role with no pair at all is left out.

arms.description: `run --compare`: each notes arm (the run's own notes as verified, then the baselines), all paired on the same pairs.

scan.description: Each dependency's scan, with every change the static diff found (also those the code does not use).

used.description: What the project's code uses of the changes: counts over used_apis.

apis.description: Changed APIs the code uses (one API can have several changes).

old_form.description: Of the APIs, those the code uses in the old form somewhere.

files.description: Files of the project's code that use one of them.

packages.description: The packages of those APIs, in the order of used_apis.

new_packages_imported.description: Dependencies first released after the cutoff that the code imports.

used_apis.description: Each changed API the project's code uses, the old form first, with where and how, and the note from the API diff for it. A use matched by a member's name alone is here only with --include-name-matches.

notes_preview.description: The block that `since-cutoff sync` would write for the used APIs; null when there is nothing to note.

targets.description: The files sync would write it to (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md).

tokens.description: An estimate of the block's size in tokens.

block.description: The block, from its start marker to its end marker.

attempts.description: `run`: every model answer, probes first, then the held-out and regression answers without and with the notes.

notes_detail.description: `run`: each note the run wrote, with the model's example and what the held-out test measured for it.

block.description: `run`: the notes block the run wrote (`run --apply` puts it in AGENTS.md); null when no note was needed.

skipped_changes.description: `run`: the API changes that got no probe, with why.

interval.description: A 95% interval as [low, high]; null when it cannot be computed.

form.description: old_form: the code uses the API as the release at the cutoff allowed and the pinned release no longer does; uses_api: it uses the API otherwise.

match.description: How the use was matched: path (an import path of the API), name (by package and name: a diff with no import paths), name_only (a member's name alone; only with --include-name-matches).

settings.description: What the numbers depend on: the tool, the diff, the margin and, after `run`, the run's settings.

diff_schema.description: The version of the API diff's format (apidiff.DIFF_SCHEMA); cached diffs of another version are made again.

griffe_version.description: The griffe that read the sources for the diff.

cutoff_margin.description: Days before the cutoff that the comparison release had to be published by.

model_source.description: `run` without `--model`: the agent setting the model was read from.

task_model.description: `run`: the model that wrote the tasks and notes.

effort.description: `run`: the thinking effort of the model calls.

prompt_version.description: `run`: the version of the task, solver and note prompts; cached tasks and answers of another version are not reused.

heldout_used.description: `run`: the held-out tasks per failure there were, when fewer than `heldout` asked for.

regression.description: `run --regression`: previously correct APIs checked again with the notes.

python_version.description: `run`: the Python version the answers were type-checked for.

tasks_from.description: `run --tasks-from`: the tasks file; null when the run's task writer wrote the tasks.

tasks_written_by.description: `run --tasks-from`: who wrote those tasks, as the file says.

compare.description: `run --compare`: the baseline arms compared with the notes.

package.description: The distribution's canonical name on PyPI.

locked.description: The version the project pins (or resolves to).

locked_date.description: The day that version was released.

cutoff_version.description: The release it is compared from: the latest one published by compare_from.

cutoff_version_date.description: The day that release was published.

imported.description: Whether the project's code imports the package; null when its import names are unknown (its files were not read).

breaking_changes.description: Breaking changes to its public APIs, each counted once.

deprecations.description: New deprecations of its public APIs, each counted once.

internal_changes.description: Changes to its internal APIs, counted apart.

probed.description: `run`: valid probes of its changes (0 in scan).

stale.description: `run`: probe answers that used the API as it was at the cutoff.

wrong.description: `run`: probe answers that were wrong otherwise.

deprecated.description: `run`: probe answers that used a deprecated API.

excluded.description: `run`: probes not counted (the answer did not touch the package, went off task, did not parse, or the call failed).

reason.description: Why it was not checked, or a remark on how it was; null otherwise.

package_status.description: changed: its API changed after the cutoff; unchanged: no breaking change; known: the pinned release came out before the cutoff; new: first released after the cutoff; skipped: not checked.

version_source.description: Where that version comes from (pinned, locked, installed, latest).

direct.description: Whether the project declares it itself (not only as a dependency of a dependency).

imported.description: Whether the project's code imports it; null when unknown.

cutoff_version.description: The release it is compared from.

cutoff_version_date.description: The day that release was published.

locked_date.description: The day the pinned version was released.

import_names.description: The top-level modules the pinned release provides.

reason.description: Why it was not checked; null otherwise.

first_released.description: status new: the day of its first release.

summary.description: status new: its one-line summary on PyPI.

changelog.description: Where it documents its releases (a Changelog URL, else its GitHub releases page); null when PyPI lists neither.

unread.description: What the diff could not compare: compiled modules without a source or stub, classes with a base outside the package.

reexported.description: Modules that take their names from another distribution that could not be read, with why: changes to them are not reported.

changes.description: Every change the static diff found, once per public path that leads to it (the counts count each once).

api_change.description: One change from the static API diff (apidiff.APIChange). Its fields follow settings.diff_schema; the ones listed are those integrations read.

path.description: The changed object's public path (for a parameter: its callable's).

name.description: The object's name (a switched dependency: the distribution no longer required).

owner.description: The class of a changed member; null for a module-level object.

parameter.description: The parameter, for a parameter change.

deprecation.description: deprecated: the library's own message, from the pinned release.

import_paths.description: The shortest of the public paths that lead to it (at most 5; import_paths_total counts them all); null in a diff that did not record them.

import_paths_total.description: How many public paths lead to it.

tier.description: public: an API the package presents (reached from its top level, in an __all__, or documented); internal: the rest, counted apart.

change_kind.description: What changed: removed, moved, a parameter removed, now required, keyword-only or positional-only, changed kind (class to function), deprecated, or a dependency the package switched away from.

cutoff_version.description: The release it is compared from.

versions_from.description: The file that pins it (uv.lock, pyproject.toml), installed, or PyPI's latest.

display.description: How the reports name it under its package (Messages.create, hf_hub_download).

form.description: old_form when the code uses any of its changes in the old form somewhere, else uses_api.

match.description: The strongest match among its uses.

changes.description: Its changes, each with the form the code uses it in.

change_id.description: The change's id, as in attempts and notes_detail.

runtime.description: What the pinned release's source shows of run time; nothing was run (checked is always false).

still_handled_at.description: A removed parameter: where the source still reads it (pkg/module.py:line), so calls passing it may still run.

still_named_at.description: A switched dependency: where the source still names the old distribution.

replacement.description: The first of replacements, or null.

used_in.description: The files that use it, relative to the project, with /.

locations.description: One entry per place the code uses it, most specific use first. File-level until the scan records lines (issue #8): line, column and code are null until then.

installed.description: A switched dependency: the project's own entry for the distribution the package no longer requires; null when it lists none, and for every other API.

source.description: The file that pins it, installed, or unpinned.

file.description: The file, relative to the project, with / (empty when unknown).

line.description: 1-based line; null until the scan records lines.

column.description: 0-based column; null until the scan records lines.

kind.description: How the code uses it: keyword (passes a parameter), call, member (reads it), reference, dependency (a switched distribution).

code.description: The line of code, at most 200 characters, read when the report is written; null without a line.

replacement.description: What to use instead, and where that comes from.

evidence.description: Why it is taken for one: library_text, move_checked, probable_rename or requires_dist.

source.description: Where the evidence is (the library's file, the diff).

exists_in_locked.description: Whether the replacement exists in the pinned version.

applies_to.description: The versions a note is about.

version.description: The pinned version it applies to.

cutoff_version.description: The release it is compared from.

checks.description: What was checked for a note, and what was not.

change.description: How the change was found (the static API diff, with the versions and diff schema).

replacement.description: How each replacement was checked; null without one.

example_type_checks.description: true for a [type-checked] note (a model's example that basedpyright accepts for the pinned version); false for the note from the diff that replaced one whose example did not; null when no example was checked.

runtime.description: What is known of run time; nothing was run.

measured.description: `run` (notes_detail): what the held-out test measured for the note's changes; null otherwise.

outcome.description: fixed, broken or neither, for a note about one change; null for several.

note.description: The note from the API diff for a used API (notes_detail has more after `run`).

tags.description: What was checked: diff, library, type_checked, metadata, ...

tag_text.description: The tags as the block writes them ([diff + library]).

not_confirmed.description: Names in the pinned version that look similar, not confirmed as replacements (never in the note).

change_id.description: The first change the note covers.

example.description: The model's example; null for a note from the diff.

verified.description: The older name of checks.example_type_checks being true: kept because results.json has always had it.

source.description: model, diff, or a --compare baseline's arm.

writer.description: The model that wrote a model's note; null otherwise.

valid.description: Probes whose answer could be scored.

pass.description: Answers that type-check against the pinned version and use the changed API.

stale.description: Answers that use the API as it was at the cutoff.

deprecated.description: Answers that use a deprecated API.

changes_without_tasks.description: API changes that got no usable task (skipped_changes).

cached_answers.description: Answers taken from the cache instead of the model.

verified.description: The older name of type_checked: the same number.

type_checked.description: Notes whose example type-checked against the pinned version.

from_diff.description: Notes from the API diff (no model example).

tokens.description: An estimate of the block's size in tokens.

pairing.description: Held-out answers compared task by task, without vs with the notes, and the statistics on them.

fixed.description: Pairs wrong without the notes and correct with them.

broken.description: Pairs correct without the notes and wrong with them.

changes_fixed.description: Changes with more than half of their pairs wrong without the notes and correct with them.

changes_broken.description: Changes fixed the other way round.

changes_still_correct.description: regression: changes still correct with the notes (more than half of their pairs).

ci95_changes_still_correct.description: regression: the Wilson interval of changes_still_correct.

difference.description: With minus without, over all counted pairs (a fraction); null without pairs.

ci95_difference.description: The cluster bootstrap interval of difference (resampling changes); null with fewer than two changes.

ci95_changes_fixed.description: The Wilson interval of changes_fixed of changes.

sign_test_p.description: The exact two-sided sign test over changes fixed vs changes broken.

tokens.description: An estimate of the arm's block size in tokens.

versus_verified.description: A baseline against the run's notes, on the changes counted in both; null for the notes themselves.

task.description: The task the model was given.

with_notes.description: Whether the model saw a notes block.

outcome.description: pass, stale, wrong or deprecated; untouched, off-task, invalid or error for an answer that is not counted.

errors.description: The type checker's errors attributed to the package.

error.description: Why the model call failed; null when it did not.

cached.description: Whether the answer came from the cache.

arm.description: `run --compare`: the arm whose block the model saw; null for an answer without notes.
